title: Ethics, record keeping and grievance
objectives: Apply the IA code of conduct.
body_md:
## Code of conduct (principles)

- **Honesty and fairness**; put the client first.
- **Diligence**: base advice on research and the client's profile.
- **Competence**: keep qualification and certification valid.
- **Confidentiality** of client data.
- **No guaranteed returns**; no misleading ads.
- **Disclose** conflicts and fees.

## Records

Keep for at least five years: agreement, profile, risk assessment, advice and rationale, communications, fee receipts.

## Audit and inspection

IAs undergo **periodic audits** and must cooperate with SEBI inspections.

## Grievances

| Step | Action |
|---|---|
| 1 | Complain to the IA and expect a timely reply |
| 2 | **SEBI SCORES** |
| 3 | **Smart ODR** |

## Advertising

Ads must be factual; include the standard risk statement; do not use past performance to promise the future.

> **Exam tip:** Records five years; no assured returns; grievance route is IA, SCORES, ODR.
example: An adviser is asked to promise 15% a year to win a client. The code forbids it; the adviser explains that no return can be guaranteed.
say: I cannot guarantee returns; here is how I will measure progress.
If I fall short, you can complain to SEBI SCORES.
